Better late than never, and this one is packed with fixes, new functionality, and quality-of-life improvements (with more on the way).[/p][p]As a [b]solo developer[/b], the game has continued to grow in scale far beyond the original plan. That makes some features harder to implement or change, so at this stage my main focus will be on:[/p][list][*][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][/*][*][p]⚖️ [b]Gameplay Balance[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🖥️ [b]UI Improvements[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🏗️ [b]Polish & Refinement + Achievements[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]That said, I’m not done adding new content! notes.title: New Horror Tycoon Update 2025
notes.notes:
[h1]🕯️ Horror Tycoon Developer Update – Experimental Branch Now Live! 🕯️
Greetings, Haunters![/h1]

It’s been a wild year so far, and I want to start by thanking you for your patience. While I’ve been a little quiet on social media, I’ve been deep in development—polishing, optimizing, and improving Horror Tycoon based on your amazing feedback. It’s time to lift the veil and share what’s been brewing behind the scenes.

Today, I’m excited to announce that a brand-new update is now available for testing on the Experimental/Beta branch on Steam!

This build features a slew of additions, improvements, and fixes directly inspired by your suggestions and community reviews. It will remain in the Experimental branch for a few weeks to allow time for bug testing and additional tweaks before rolling out to all players on the public branch.

[h2]🧱 New Features[/h2]
PRE-FAB Rooms (First Wave): Modular room layouts are now available to streamline your haunted house design. More styles and themes are coming soon!

In-Game Owner’s Manual (WIP): A tutorial/guide system has been added to assist both new and returning players. You can access it by pressing F9.

Keyboard Arrow Support: You can now use the left and right arrow keys to pan the camera.

[h2]🔧 Gameplay Changes & Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
Body Disposal Employees are now managed through the Services Menu—just like other employees.

These employees can now be upgraded, boosting their movement speed with each level.

Items eligible for breakdowns now last longer before failing.

Starting modes now grant more starting money and fear reputation, giving you a stronger launch.

Increased guest count per wave to ramp up challenge and immersion.

“Maybe A Slice of Pie” now speeds up body disposal based on its level.

Soul Meter Overhaul (WIP): Now requires only 10 souls to activate. It does not consume souls—just a requirement to use the upcoming Ultimate ability. Currently in testing, feedback welcome!

Guests now buy food and drinks when walking past concession stands, offering bonus revenue per wave.

Part Lists are now visible in item detail views:

Green = parts in inventory

Red = parts missing

Bonus: Store category icons added for faster browsing.

Part Names have been standardized for better readability and searchability.

Pressing M with an item selected will now move it directly—no need to go through the build menu every time. (Cooldowns still apply during waves.)

Guest Exit Animation has been updated. Guests now run when fleeing!

Item scroll list size reduced by 20% for easier browsing.

Power Areas now show a yellow grid when placing powered items, improving clarity for new players.

[h2]🧹 Bug Fixes[/h2]
Resolved hover animation issues in the Main Menu and Difficulty Select screen.

Fixed item filter reset problems in build mode.

Police should no longer investigate while the game is paused.

Fixed bugs related to save/load system, including disappearing saves and unsaved spawned items.

Resolved issues in Sandbox mode showing locked items.

Fixed visual clipping on Body Disposal employee's feet.

[h2]👻 Known Issues (Under Investigation)[/h2]
In-Game Manual still in development – Press F9 to preview.

Some strange behavior from police AI is being looked into.

A minor stutter (1-2 seconds) may occur when placing Body Disposal Offices.

Soul Meter is currently non-functional, but visual tracking is live. Activation effects coming soon!

Thank you again for being part of this twisted little community. Your feedback is crucial in shaping Horror Tycoon, and I’m incredibly excited to see what you think of this next chapter. Head over to the Experimental Branch on Steam to try it out—and don’t forget to share your thoughts in the forums or Discord!

Stay spooky,
Casey aka 3pm

notes.title: Management Update
notes.notes:
Hey Haunters! It’s time for some spooky updates! After months of hard work, I am excited to roll out the latest changes to enhance your haunted house experience! PLEASE NOTE: Some of the new features and gameplay elements are still in development and a work in progress. Previous save games may not work correctly with new builds, use those at your own risk. As with any update, please use the Steam Forums or Discord Channel to provide feedback or report additional bugs. 

🔍 Major Changes: Gameplay Balance Shift
Old Balance: 90% Tower Defense | 10% Management
New Balance: 60% Tower Defense | 40% Management
This update introduces a wealth of new management features while keeping Sandbox/Creative modes untouched.

🚀 Future Plans
We’ll be gathering player feedback to refine the game further, fix any bugs, and polish existing features.

💰 Price Increase Notice
Heads up! Due to the increased content and development efforts, a slight price increase will happen soon. Now's your chance to snag Horror Tycoon at the current price (USD $14.99) the new price (USD $17.99 will go in effect in 2025)!

🛠️ New Features & Improvements
Power Management

Off the Grid Power Supply: 
Manage power for your attractions, with requirements displayed on item cards.

Fuel Management: Generators require fuel, which can be added manually or via a mechanic.

Upgrading Generators: Reduces refueling duration and cost without increasing power output.
Breakdowns & Repairs

Item Breakdowns: 
Electrical and motorized items can now break down.
Repairs: Replacements require parts; repairs can be handled by you or hired mechanics.

Peculiar Parts Store:
Purchase Replacement Parts: Acquire parts for broken items, with stock varying based on suppliers.
Mechanics Office

Hire Mechanics: Assist with repairs and refueling.
Prioritize Tasks: Choose between repairs or refueling for mechanics.

Customer Service Office:
Mini Game Challenge: Negotiate payouts and generate passive income through customer service events.

😱 New Fear Meter & First-Person Mode
Fear Meter: A new HUD feature enhancing guest interaction.  - WORK IN PROGRESS - 
Ultimate Abilities: Triggered when the fear meter is full, unleashing terrifying effects on guests. - WORK IN PROGRESS - 

Abilities Include - WORK IN PROGRESS-:
Inferno: Ignites all guests, causing damage over time.
Electro Shock: Electrocutes guests, inflicting damage over time.
Cold Wave: Freezes guests, slowing them and causing damage.
Let’s Make a Deal: Steals wallets from guests for a cash boost.
Heart-O-Tack: Causes immediate heart attacks, resulting in guest deaths.
Blood Bath: Makes guests bleed uncontrollably, causing damage over time.

First-Person Mode Scares:
Guest Camera Mode: Scare guests directly in first person.
Scare Stamina Bar: Depletes with each scare and recharges over time.
Tactical Scares: Use scares wisely to maximize effectiveness and impact.

⚙️ Gameplay Enhancements
Sinister Trap Re-Design: New soul meter replaces traps, allowing powerful abilities when filled.
Ultimate Abilities Include: Inferno, Electrocution, Cold Wave, Let’s Make a Deal, Heart-O-Tack, Blood Bath.

📈 Quality of Life Improvements
Fixed Build Window Issue: Move items without reopening the build window after a countdown.
Visual & Audio Effects: Enhanced upgrading experience for a more immersive feel.
Height Lock Key [X]: Lock item height for consistent placement.
Multi-Level Building: Now possible, still in progress for further improvements.

🐞 Bug Fixes & Minor Changes
UI Improvements: Resolved issues with power indicators, item cards, and selection buttons.
New Scare Traps: Blood Boil and Witches Cauldron added to your arsenal.
Item Rotations: Improved control over item placement for better customization.
First-Person Mode Improvements: Removed single-story roof and fixed level fall-through issues.
Stability Fixes: General bug fixes and improved level design for a smoother experience.
Added Items: New coffins (Wooden with/without lids, Concrete with/without lids) for more decor options.
Wall Adjustments: Walls can now be raised and lowered for easier layout management.
Game Progression Fix: Resolved an issue where stuck guests prevented game progression after the final wave.
FPS Scare Mode Fix: Ensured manual scaring is only possible in Guest Cam mode.
Poster Flicker Fix: Fixed flickering issues with missing posters in Z space.
Tooltip Fixes: Phobias now show correctly in item tooltips without duplication.
Construction Mode Visibility Fix: Filters for floors and walls now consistently visible in construction mode.
Blood Boil Trap Adjustment: This trap can now be raised or lowered by players.
Sandbox Mode Fix: Service items and employees can no longer be placed in sandbox mode, which doesn't require power generators.
Decor Prop Fix: The fireplace prop is now unlocked from the start.
Placement Guide Fix: The guide box is now visible when placing certain items.
Power Supply Fix: Ensured power supplies are inactive when turned off.
Breakdown Fix: Fixed an issue where items could still break down while OFF.
Finance Screen Update: Added an advertising & marketing campaign feature to generate Fear reputation every 30 seconds at a cost.
Pathfinding Improvements: Enhanced the Body Cleanup Service’s pathfinding and collision issues.
Wall Filter Update: New filter for construction items, including accessories for trusses and supports.
Body Parts Adjustment: Body parts will no longer spawn under floors.

🙏 Thank You!
I appreciate your ongoing support and feedback. Dive into the new update, explore the exciting management features, and let me know what you think!

Happy Haunting! 🕷️

notes.title: Major Update Two - Out Now!
notes.notes:
Greeting Haunters,

   I have been working on the next update for several months. This update contains bug fixes, changes, a new level and additional new content added. Thank you again for your continued support while I develop and further improve the game. As previously stated there is still a long road ahead and I am happy you are here and coming along on this journey with me as I work towards the final release of the game (date TBA). 

Here are the patch notes:

[h2]FIXES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue when loading a normal game, it would load in the sandbox version of the HUD.
[*] SANDBOX - fixed an issue when starting a new level, guests would automatically spawn into the level before pressing GO.
[*] Fixed an issue with the GO button still being enabled on the final wave. 
[*] Fixed an issue when displaying tooltips they would sometimes be shown behind a widget and be impossible to read fully.
[*] Fixed an issue when hovering over the early access text, animations would not fade in or out correctly.
[*] Fixed Level selection screen so the level select button can not be spammed which caused an animation and sound effect glitch.
[*] Fixed an issue where players had to press the quick slot button twice for it to activate a player activated trap.
[*] Fixed the FX - Triggered Light to show no color on the lenses, however, when clicked on the light will turn on to see current light color.
[*] Fixed an issue where moving the scare item details panel was impossible. 
[*] Fixed an issue where exiting the in-game menu would make the Quick Slot / User Activated traps button to be un-clickable.
[*] Fixed an issue where entering guest camera mode would leave existing guest camera locations visible in the world.
[*] Fixed text formatting issues in end of level stats.
[*] Fixed an issue when clicking on the test guest the guest would slow down.
[*] Fixed an issue where guests were taking too much damage and dying immediately. 
[*] Fixed an issue when placing new items after one that can be raised or lowered, the new item regardless if it can be raised or lowered would remain at the same height as the item that was previously placed.  Now, when placing multiple items of the same type, the height information will be remembered until a different / new item has been placed. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the upgrade progress bar would not show the current upgrade amount correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were unable to select a new level regardless of meeting the player level requirements.
[*] Fixed an issue where Test Guest would get scared by traps, they should no longer be scared by traps when walking through your haunt.
[*] Fixed an issue where the bloody floor decor item could not be selected.
[*] Fixed an issue where the police report (when a crime was detected) would not be able to be clicked on.
[*] Fixed an issue where if the player had 0 fear reputation but enough cash, items that cost 0 fear reputation were unable to be purchased.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Haunted House name would not show correctly on the police report.
[*] Fixed an issue when the timer reaches 0, guests spawn, however the timer does not restart nor did the wave count increase.
[*] THE FOREST - Fixed an issue where the camera was behaving oddly due to tree collisions. 
[*] THE ABANDONED FACTORY - Fixed an issue where the police could not reach the haunt entrance.
[*] Fixed an issue where the players level and XP would not be displayed correctly in the next level.
[*] Fixed an issue where guests death particles would not be displayed. Different traps have different effect variations.
[*] Fixed an issue when on the Level Select screen where players were unable to return back to the Backyard Haunt.
[*] Fixed an issue where skeletons had the wrong material setting and would not react to lighting properly. 
[*] Fear Reputation Icon no longer visible when playing in Sandbox mode.
[*] Fixed an issue when selecting an item that can be color changed, the changed values are not displayed correctly in the item details window.
[*] Fixed the flashlight sound fx for when turning on/off. 
[*] Fixed an issue where selecting the Maybe a Slice of Pie food vendor was impossible.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could travel through the Maybe a Slice of Pie food vendor when in Guest Camera mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where the top of the grandfather clock was missing. 
[*] Fixed an issue when spawning Guest Camera it would sometimes get the player stuck after placing new items near the camera location, the guest camera will now always start at the original starting location to prevent this from happening.
[*]  Fixed an issue where having the finance screen open would allow the player to open the main menu and still cause the menu to be visible. 
[*] Fixed an issue where having the finance screen open the player could still potentially build items.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Test Guest would activate traps.
[*] Fixed an issue where the police office would receive decals when walking over blood stains.
[*] Fixed on end of level stats when player closes the stat window, player is now taken back to the level select menu.
[*] Fixed bones and teeth accumulated now carry over from level to level.
[*] Fixed a pathing issue related to the body disposal employee, still a work in progress but this should prevent him from getting stuck as often.
[*] Fixed an issue where the body disposal employee would make all guts/blood vanish upon overlap. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the TUTORIAL that would not allow players to proceed if they did not have a Number pad keyboard. Additional key bindings have been added (PAGE UP / PAGE DOWN) for increasing / decreasing the grid size.
[*] Fixed an issue with death particles disappearing too quickly.
[*] Fixed an issue related to floor collisions. 
[*] Fixed an issue if the player is in guest camera mode at the end of the level in a non-sandbox game, guest mode will now exit to ensure the end of level stats are displayed correctly.

[h2]CHANGES[/h2]

[*] SANDBOX - No longer requires a body disposal employee to be hired.
[*] SANDBOX - Finance Button has been disabled
[*] Changed the fear reputation meter look/feel, let me know if you like version 1 or version 2 better on discord.
[*] Traffic in levels has been placed in the repair shop until it is more stable. Police however will still arrive when conditions are met.
[*] The Body Disposal employee now has glowing eyes to show possession. 
[*] Changed grass floor tile, removed tall grass to allow player more flexibility for their design.
[*] Tile Flooring can now have it's color changed.
[*] Body Disposal employee will now wait several seconds to clean an area before moving to the garbage bin.
[*] Body guts now has additional particles when cleaning.

[*] When in Guest Camera mode holding the LEFT SHIFT key will allow the player to sprint.
[*] Buildable area grids now reflect the actual buildable area shape.
[*] Updated end of level stats close window button style art
[*] THE FOREST - Reduced the amount of waves, increased the amount of souls required.
[*] THE FOREST - Increased level brightness.
[*] SANDBOX - Timer is no longer visible as the player can summon guests whenever they want.
[*] Reduced the amount of damage the barrel crash scare trap caused.
[*] Added the input shortcut to Increase grid/rotation size by pressing the "PAGE UP", "]" or "NUM +" key.
[*] Added the input shortcut to  Decrease grid/rotation size by pressing the "PAGE DOWN", "[", "NUM -" Key.
[*] Updated and replaced some UI placeholder artwork.0
[*] When upgrading an item, the upgrade level decal will be shown while the item is selected, once unselected, the decal will not be visible. 
[*] ADDED visibility to toggle the current level of all upgraded items to be displayed by pressing SHIFT+U and press SHIFT+U again to hide the upgrade decal.
[*] Game Success / Fail checks in a non-sandbox game will now see if the player has any bodies remaining that need to be disposed of and will check to see if their are any more guests spawned on the map before proceeding to a level pass/fail. The countdown timer on the final wave does not need to reach 0 any longer.
[*] When guests are at their maximum scare amount, but not scared to death, they will walk twice as fast to get to the exit.
[*] Wooden Floor 1, 2 & 3 are color changeable.

[h2]New Content[/h2]

[*] Added Body Disposal Employee Animations: Cleaning & Throwing Away.
[*] Added new scare trap: Big Spider
[*] Added new audio for Big Spider
[*] Added new scare trap: Insect Eggs
[*] New Scare Trap Added: Grandfather Clock
[*] New Audio added for Grandfather Clock.
[*] Added 5 new animal fur rugs.
[*] Added custom texture wall. This feature is still in development.
[*] Added new location: The Lake
[*] Added new decor items: Long Railing, Long Railing - Broken, Railing, Railing - Broken
[/list]

notes.title: Horror Tycoon Major Update ONE
notes.notes:
[h1]Horror Tycoon - Major Update ONE - 0.9.9r[/h1]

Greetings Haunters!  

     First, thank you for all of your support since early access launched back in October.  The game is still evolving and improving thanks to your incredible feedback.  I have been working since launch to bring the first major update to Horror Tycoon. This update contains new content, a new level + a tease of the next level location, new music, new sound fx, new gameplay elements, new features, 40+ bug fixes, balancing and more! 

As stated in the 2023 Road Map, the goal is to release a new major update every quarter (or so) until the game is ready for release. Each major update will contain new content as well as gameplay improvements and bug fixes. In between quarters, smaller patches and bug fixes will be implemented. 

The next update and its features will be announced sometime in Q2 2023. Until then... please see the full patch notes below:

[h2]Gameplay Changes: [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247701/2fd8ff8aaed879d48db2620186e31072e0130495.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] In Sandbox mode players can now select the next wave difficulty from the wave details panel (Top Center of the main User Interface)
[*] Food & Drink items now have their own tab on the main Hud. The Pre-Fab tab has been removed.
[*] Main HUD "Go" button will now animate when the next wave of guests can enter the haunt.
[*] When the next wave can be called in a non-sandbox game there is now an audio reminder. The Devil will taunt the player slightly to begin the next wave.
[*] When a guest encounters a vending machine and obtains food or drink, an icon will now appear to better communicate the guest has received the buff (increases heart attack chance).
[*] Increase Guest Heart Attack will have a duration so these will need to be placed strategically to ensure guests have this buff when entering the desired scare traps. This buff does not stack, placing multiple vending machines in a row will not further increase the chance for a heart attack.
[*] The different vending machines will now also advise what percentage they will increase a guest's heart attack chance in the description (the more expensive the vending machine, the higher the heart attack chance). 
[/list]

[*] Fixed an issue where Decor Items would get stuck in place when raising or lowering them.
[*] General Optimization and Performance fixes.

notes.title: Holiday Update 0.9.8f
notes.notes:
Hello Haunters!
It's hard to believe it has already been a month since Early Access launched! Let's do a quick recap of the past 4 weeks: 

[list]
[*] Early access launched on October 20th.
[*] 8 Updates have been released since early access launched.
[*] 50+ Bug fixes/quality of life features implemented.
[/list]

What's next? 
Immediate: 1-2 more smaller updates are still to be released before the end of 2022. 
Short term: First major update is coming in Q1 of 2023 (Details of what that update will contain will be revealed at a later date)

This update introduces new decor, construction items and a new scare trap to use in your haunted house attractions as well as further bug fixes and quality of life updates. Here's a sneak peak at some of those new items and scare traps: 

Scare your guests with floating books that move from side to side (great for placing book cases on both sides of a corridor for a spooky library vibe)

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247701/4848d3ded8c50a6004b1fcbfc96604090bbabf07.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.9.8 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Haunters,
 Thank you so much for your continued support and all of your help identifying bugs or issues that you may have experienced. Keep these reports coming in, I am working through fixing them as quickly as possible. Some bugs may take longer to fix than others, but they are being worked on.  Also, I value and welcome your feedback and suggestions on my discord or here in the Steam discussion forums for Horror Tycoon. 

With the holidays quickly approaching here in the USA there will be fewer updates in the month of December but will resume in January. 

Horror Tycoon will see the first major content update coming sometime in the first quarter of 2023, more details will be revealed at a later date.

[b]Please find the new update patch notes below: [/b]
[b][i]Note: Previous saves may cause crashes or unknown behavior. It is recommended for you to delete any previous saves. [/i][/b]

[list]
[*] Save/Load system is functional. There may still be some bugs or issues regarding some saved stats or item properties, but this should now at least allow you to save your progress and return at a later date.
[*] Fixed an issue where a traps blue trigger sphere would be visible once a game has been loaded.
[*] Added a new splash helper image to explain game mechanics.
[*] Loading should now detect if a wave was already in progress and spawn guests accordingly.
[*] UI should now load after loading a saved game. 
[*] Added 2 new input options for camera control/remapping. 
[*]   - Rotate Camera
[*]   - Zoom
[*] Body Disposal Employee can now be unpossessed and re-possessed (will cost an additional soul)
[*] Item placement Grid size now reflects the changes visually when increased or decreased.
[*] Guest HP Bar now shows Phobias.
[*] Phobias are now in color for easier identification.
[*] Updated fear reputation requirements for upgrading existing traps. 
[*] Grid size now shows the correct selected grid size when placing new items.
[*] Fixed an issue with the chandelier blocking guests.
[*] Adjusted guest spawn amounts.
[*] Guests will no longer attempt to cut through the neighbor's yard to enter the backyard.
[*] Police officer will no longer attempt to cut through the neighbor's backyard.
[*] If loading a game and the intro and contract have already been signed, the game will now start at the build location.
[*] Added "=" and "-" keyboard mapping to increase and decrease grid size for players that do not have a num pad keyboard.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access - Bugs, Crashes and more update

Greetings Haunters!

You can expect to see a new update roll out sometime later this week that should address some of the more serious issues (Fatal Errors/Crashes) that have been reported.

Thank you for your understanding and patience as I work to implement these fixes. 

-Casey 
Horror Tycoon Developer

notes.title: April Update 0.7.6
notes.notes:
Significant changes and improvements. 

---4/27/2022---
- Finance screen takes the player to a computer terminal now inside of an office.

- Police will only come to investigate once a wave can be manually called (1/2 of the countdown timer remaining).

- Cars will now stop if within range of a police car.

- Lawyer Intro can now be skipped with spacebar.

- Fixed an issue where traffic would sometimes get backed up and stop working. 

- Fixed an issue where clicking on bones and teeth were difficult to click on.

- Bones now fall to the ground after the body has been dissolved.

- Fixed an issue where player could click anywhere on bloodline agreement page.

------4/13/2022------

- New resource collecting gameplay element implemented. Collect bones and teeth from guests that die.

- Unlock new items with Bones/Teeth collected from guests that die.

- UI is currently undergoing a new visual style. Build Items are completed. Other menus will receive makeovers as well.

- Backyard haunt neighborhood has been completely re-designed due to new traffic/streets. 

- Tutorial has been updated this is not the final version of the tutorial but will provide players with information regarding the HUD.

- New sound FX added.

- New guest death visuals added.

- Added rodents to the world

- General bugs and stability fixes.
